exposure: COVID-19 vaccination status (number of inactivated vaccine doses: 0, 1, 2, or 3)
outcome: Incidence rate of Omicron infection by trimester
Length of hospital stay for mothers
SARS-CoV-2 IgG positive rate in mothers
Mild adverse reactions in mothers (fatigue, loss of appetite)
Newborn SARS-CoV-2 IgG and IgM antibody status
cohort: A total of 1,024 pregnant women infected with the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant and 120 of their newborns were enrolled in Shanghai, China.
finding: Three doses of COVID-19 vaccination significantly shortened hospitalization time and increased SARS-CoV-2 IgG positive rates in pregnant women infected with the Omicron variant, and was considered safe for newborns with no impact on Apgar scores or SARS-CoV-2 status.
mod_finding: Maternal COVID-19 vaccination did not affect the choice of future delivery mode.
followup_time: Immediately after birth for newborns, and throughout pregnancy for mothers.
